what: crates/hir-def/src/nameres/demand.rs: two per-crate Vecs grow by doubling, so a warm check of a crate allocates about log2(bodies) more times as it grows. That fails blaze-diagnostics lints::bodies::tests::late_passes_per_crate (10 allocations at 4 bodies, 19 at 64; trace in /tmp/blaze-lanes/trace-late_passes_per_crate.txt). (a) crate_body_owners (line 120) via push_scope_body_owners: owners grows 32 to 1024 B. Size it once: count each module scope first (unnamed_consts plus declarations, an upper bound) and reserve that total before the push loop, or reserve per scope in push_scope_body_owners. (b) every_body (line 177): bodies grows 32 to 1024 B. Use Vec::with_capacity(roots.len()) from crate_body_owners, and have walk_bodies hand back its own queue or seen count so nested bodies (rare) only grow it then. walk_bodies one seen set (1160 B) is a single allocation and fine. body_owners in blaze-diagnostics allocates a fixed number of times per crate, so it is not the growth.
